text:
Maya (Marketing): @here planning a quick deconflict — webinar goes live Thur 09:00 PST. We have X thread + LinkedIn post + follow-up carousel. Need to agree timing so posts don't cannibalize each other.
Liam (Content): I'm thinking teaser posts Tue/Wed, main blast Thur 09:05 PST, follow-up Thur 12:00 PST (thread on X) and LinkedIn native article at 09:30. Thoughts?
Aria (Social): Can we shift LinkedIn to 09:20? LinkedIn engagement often lags 15-30m. Also prefer X thread at 09:00 to capture live registrants.
Maya (Marketing): Good point. Proposal: X thread 09:00 PST (short live thread + CTA), LinkedIn post 09:20 PST (expanded narrative + image carousel), reply-stitch follow-ups at 11:00 & 13:00 PST. Everyone ok?
Sam (Growth): Need to coordinate inbound routing — if we spike, SDR ops should get the hot leads within 30m. Alex (SDR) can you confirm capacity?
Alex (SDR): We can handle up to 150 warm leads/hr, after that we'll need overflow to inbound@redwood.com. Please include 'webinar-041' utm in links.
Nora (Design): I'll push final carousel + social-size hero by Tue EOD. Shared link: https://drive.redwood/designs/webinar-041 :white_check_mark:
Liam (Content): Also prepping 3 variations of the X thread headline for quick A/B midschedule. Will drop copy in the thread: 
```
1) Unlock inference at scale — join our webinar
2) How we cut token costs 3x — live demo
3) Hands-on: Deploy performant LLM inference
```
Aria (Social): Can we run variant 2 for paid amplification and variant 1 organic? Sam I'll need budget callout by Wed.
Sam (Growth): Allocated $1.2k for X paid push. Target: eng startups + product managers. Will route click-to-registration to /webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar-041
Maya (Marketing): Routing notes: use /lp/webinar-041 and add parameter ?source=channel to capture. SDR tag = webinar-041. Also add hidden field for 'invite_code' to de-dupe.
DeployBot: Scheduled post created by @Aria for channel #x-announce at 1754247600 (Thu 09:00 PST) :robot_face:
Aria (Social): I'll schedule X thread draft now and set LinkedIn for 09:20. Tagging design for final images. :rocket:
Nora (Design): Uploaded final images to drive and compressed for LinkedIn carousel. file names: hero_041.jpg, slide1_041.png, slide2_041.png
Liam (Content): Quick checklist for copy handoff:
- Headline variants (done)
- 2 CTAs (Register / Watch the Replay)
- UTM + SDR tag (webinar-041)
- One-sentence summary for LinkedIn card
I'll paste everything in the content doc by Tue 10:00 PST.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Final ask: please avoid posting other major campaigns Thu 08–14 PST to reduce noise. If anything else is priority, flag here now.
Sam (Growth): Noted. Will freeze other paid pushes in that window. :lock:
Aria (Social): I'll monitor for replies and route high intent via webhook to SDR. Will post engagement playbook in channel when live.
Alex (SDR): Please include contact@ in registration confirmation so we can follow up. I'll stand by Thu 09:00–11:00 PST.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — we'll reconvene Wed 11:00 PST for final go/no-go. If any blockers please ping me directly. :raised_hands:
